coverage: JEE Main April 2019 Paper 1 (B.E./B.Tech.) final answer keys for all eight shifts held from 8 to 12 April 2019.
exclusions: The January 2019 final answer key is excluded because no current official NTA copy was found. Question papers, Paper 2 B.Arch/B.Planning keys, provisional keys and third-party worked solutions are also excluded.
hostingPolicy: Link-only. The PDF remains on the official NTA website and is not mirrored by JEENEETARD.
